232-678-728.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Repeat.

1263-2060-3899-6701.description:
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1263-2060-3899-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

1086-1981-2415-5686.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1086-1981-2415-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

4369-4452-7855.notablePrerequisites: You are able to put a counter on The Red Terror.
4369-4452-7855.description:
Put a counter on The Red Terror.
The Great Goblin's first ability triggers, as The Red Terror is a Goblin, Orc or Army due to Rukarumel, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

341-1621-2350-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

338-6719-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-6719-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4478-5470-6188.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
4478-5470-6188.description:
Create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Fear of Missing Out token.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Move to your combat phase and declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, untapping Ghired and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

2557-4682-7132.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more than once.
2557-4682-7132.description:
Activate Super-Skrull's fourth ability by paying {5}{U}, causing an opponent to draw four cards.
Smothering Tithe triggers four times, causing you to create two Treasure tokens for each time the opponent cannot pay for the trigger.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}.
Repeat.
2557-4682-7132.notes:
If the opponent can pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more times, you can still perform the combo if you have enough mana to outlast their mana supply. You can also continue this combo for other opponents if mana allows.
The extra mana can be used to activate any of Super-Skrull's abilities.

280-423-872-1437--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
280-423-872-1437--85.description:
Cast Scaled Herbalist by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Scaled Herbalist spell three times.
Resolve the first Scaled Herbalist copy.
Activate the Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

4976-5147-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
4976-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Open the Graves and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

3497-4594-7070.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
3497-4594-7070.description:
Activate Spirit en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Spirit en-Kor.
The Spirit en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Spirit en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler.
Repeat.

3169-4050-6073-6992.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of creatures equal to or greater than 7 plus Leonardo's commander tax, if applicable.
3169-4050-6073-6992.description:
Cast Leonardo either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W} due to its cost reduction.
When Leonardo enters, Angelic Sell-Sword and Genesis Chamber trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Leonardo, adding {W}.
Put Leonardo into the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat.

224-280-1772-6763.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

2634-5148-5860.notablePrerequisites: You control a basic Mountain, a basic Island and at least three other basic lands.
2634-5148-5860.description:
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Early Harvest by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Early Harvest
Resolve the Early Harvest copy, untapping all basic lands you control.
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

1947-2646-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1947-2646-3327-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Dargo using Reckless Barbarian's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

719-4094-4508-5880.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
You control another nonland permanent.
719-4094-4508-5880.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

618-2921-3742.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Phantom Steed.
When the Phantom Steed token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Phantom Steed token.
When the Phantom Steed token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

710-2034-2843.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Danitha, adding {C}{C}.
When Danitha dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

372-1567-1809.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Momentary Blink exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1567-1809.description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Returned Pastcaller and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Returned Pastcaller trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Momentary Blink.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Returned Pastcaller and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2316-2440-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2316-2440-4050.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
When the Goblins enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers three times, adding {C}{C}{C} for each Goblin you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2590-5330-5776.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2590-5330-5776.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as a Food due to Ygra, Experimental Confectioner's second ability and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

261-4186-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
261-4186-4279.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Suture Priest and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Suture Priest and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

905-2178-2944.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Termination Facilitator.
Termination Facilitator does not have summoning sickness.
905-2178-2944.description:
Activate Termination Facilitator by tapping it, targeting any creature.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
When the creature dies, Termination Facilitator triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
 You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

662-1651-4917.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Jan Jansen to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing a creature, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two Treasure tokens, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure token, creating two 1/1 Construct creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two Construct tokens, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat from step 2.

1982-2452-5220.description:
Cast Sidisi by paying {0}.
Sidisi's exploit ability triggers, sacrificing itself.
Sidisi dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Sidisi on top of your library.
Sidisi's second ability triggers, searching your library for Sidisi, putting it into your hand and shuffling your library.
Repeat.

967-1806-2604-4050-4666.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding one mana of any color.
Planar Void triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Cast Eternal Scourge for {1}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Eternal Scourge, allowing it to enter the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

600-1124-1180.notablePrerequisites: Nicol Bolas has at least four loyalty counters on it.
600-1124-1180.description:
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you to activate each planeswalker's loyalty abilities an extra time this turn.
Activate Nicol Bolas using Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player this turn.
Activate Nicol Bolas using Jace's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, creating two copies of Nicol Bolas.
Repeat from step 2 using a Nicol Bolas token instead.
Once you have infinite Nicol Bolas tokens, each one that can still activate a loyalty ability may do so, allowing you to draw any number of cards and cause each opponent to exile that many cards from their hand and/or permanents they control; and creating any number of Illusion creature tokens by using them to activate Jace's -2 ability.
